children: BIO-key International entered into multiple Exchange Agreements with Streeterville Capital to retire the remaining balance of a secured promissory note. The company partitioned the note into four tranches totaling $416,315.80 and exchanged them for 247,805 common shares, resulting in the Original Note being paid in full. The transaction reduces debt and is expected to simplify the capital structure.
: Debt-for-equity exchange agreements to retire secured promissory note
: Retire debt and strengthen balance sheet
